title: Accept valid quantity boundaries
objective: Confirm that the documented minimum and maximum quantities are accepted.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in DRAFT state.
The order has a line whose quantity can be changed.

steps.action: Set the order-line quantity to the value specified by the current subtest and submit the change.
steps.expected_result: The submitted quantity is accepted for the DRAFT order line.

subtests.title: Minimum valid quantity
subtests.expected_result: The submitted quantity is accepted for the DRAFT order line.

subtests.title: Maximum valid quantity
subtests.expected_result: The submitted quantity is accepted for the DRAFT order line.

postconditions: The order line retains the last accepted quantity.
cleanup: Restore or remove the synthetic order.
notes: BVA and EP values are consolidated as subtests because the setup, action, and oracle are shared.
